metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for federal procurement and government property work.

plugins.name: procurement-market-research
plugins.description: Research suppliers, public pricing, and procurement evidence for federal buyers and prime contractors.

plugins.name: government-property-ltdd-relief-letter-generator
plugins.description: Generate or validate fact-based, audit-defensive Government Property LTDD relief packages under FAR 52.245-1(f)(1)(vii)(B).

plugins.name: government-property-receipt-discrepancy
plugins.description: Generate or validate concise correspondence about undocumented GFP arrivals, shipment differences, and unresolved accountable contracts.

plugins.name: government-property-written-direction-request-generator
plugins.description: Draft or validate concise requests for written Government direction on proposed property actions, conflicting instructions, and unresolved next steps.

plugins.name: government-property-contract-transfer-guide
plugins.description: Explain Government property contract transfer scenarios, prepare documentation questions, and review plans without deciding authorization.

plugins.name: software-saas-negotiation-strategy
plugins.description: Prepare evidence-based SaaS negotiation questions, strategies, and practice for acquisitions under the SAT.

plugins.name: far-compliant-commercial-item-determination
plugins.description: Research public evidence and prepare buyer guidance and procurement-file-ready commercial product, commercial service, and COTS determinations under applicable FAR definitions.

plugins.name: far-compliant-non-competitive-source-justification
plugins.description: Research suppliers, alternatives, and public pricing, then create evidence-based noncompetitive source justifications for federal prime-contractor subcontract files.

plugins.name: far-compliant-price-analysis-for-goods
plugins.description: Research public price evidence and draft procurement-file-ready price analysis for government-funded FFP goods and routine commercial buys.

plugins.name: far-compliant-price-analysis-for-subcontracts-lite
plugins.description: Draft BID SUMMARY & PRICE ANALYSIS write-ups for new subcontract awards, option exercises, and modifications, with supported price comparisons, conditional cost-element review, and a final findings table.

plugins.name: indirect-and-commercial-price-analysis-for-services-lite
plugins.description: Draft concise, evidence-based price analyses for a company's Commercial and Indirect purchases without assuming federal acquisition requirements.
